initialBuild.description:
Everything listed below is "in order" of priority

# DAMAGE PRESET

## TAB 1

- [[talent:6]] -> [[talent:5]] -> 50 points [[talent:88]] -> [[talent:266]] -> [[talent:11]] 
- [[talent:10]] (upgrade according to accuracy needed) -> Return max [[talent:11]] -> [[talent:268]] -> [[talent:13]]

## TAB 2

- [[talent:277]] -> [[talent:273]] -> [[talent:284]] -> 40 points [[talent:270]]  = 10 points [[talent:271]] 
- 40 points [[talent:274]] -> [[talent:276]] -> [[talent:278]] 
- Optional or additional points: [[talent:280]]  or [[talent:279]]

## TAB 3

- [[talent:290]] -> [[talent:293]] -> [[talent:294]] (based on alch bubble lvl) -> [[talent:292]] -> [[talent:299]] 
- 50 points [[talent:286]] = 20 points [[talent:285]] -> 1 point [[talent:287]] -> [[talent:291]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 1

- [[talent:620]] -> [[talent:616]] (capped at 10% of highest level - ie level 100 means skill level 10)
- [[talent:621]] = [[talent:624]] = [[talent:627]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 2

- [[talent:638]] (More dungeon = more damage) -> [[talent:631]] -> [[talent:634]] 
- 1 point in both [[talent:635]] and [[talent:639]]
- Optional: [[talent:632]] , [[talent:629]] [[talent:640]]

## TAB 3

- Optional: [[talent:291]]

## TAB 4

- [[talent:374]]  -> [[talent:368]] -> [[talent:367]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 1

- [[talent:621]] = [[talent:625]] = [[talent:620]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 2

- [[talent:636]] -> [[talent:637]] -> [[talent:631]] -> [[talent:634]] 
- 1 point in both [[talent:635]] and [[talent:639]]
